metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct knowledge_reference at session granularity addressing serial order definition for optimistic concurrency control correctness proofs. It differs semantically from peer candidates (DTA focuses on deadlock detection, Spurious Abort focuses on abort classification, TicToc Serializability Proof focuses on formal proof validation) and from existing skills (which address cache eviction and executor selection—entirely different domains). The candidate establishes foundational ordering semantics using commit timestamps and physical time as tiebreaker, which is prerequisite knowledge for the TicToc framework but not redundant with it. Single support section confirms relevance to Algorithm 5 in protocol specification.
